transcript.content:
Subject: Request to Send File

Dear Assistant,

Please send the attached 'NewAccounts_Oct.csv' from the sales thread to our onboarding partner so they can start importing the new accounts.

Thank you!

Best regards,  
[Your Name]

I can't find any email or attachment named "NewAccounts_Oct.csv" in your inbox or sent folder. I can proceed, but I need a little more info:

1) Where is the file located?
   - If it’s in an email thread, please tell me who the sender/recipients or the approximate subject line or label (e.g., “Sales”, “Sales Thread”) so I can search again across other folders/labels.
   - If it’s saved in Google Drive or locally, you can (a) give me the Drive link, or (b) upload the file here.

2) Who is the onboarding partner (their email address)?  
   - I need the recipient email to send the file.

3) What would you like the email to say?  
   - I can draft a short message such as:
     "Hi [Partner Name], Attached is NewAccounts_Oct.csv from our sales thread. Please begin the import and let us know if you need anything else. Thanks, [Your Name]"
   - Or give me custom wording, CCs, or a subject line.

4) Any scheduling or attachments to include from other emails?  
   - If you want me to attach the file from an existing email, I can search again once you point me to the correct thread or label.

Tell me which option you prefer (point me to the thread, upload the file, or provide the partner email and message) and I’ll send it.

The file is saved locally on my computer. I will upload it here. The onboarding partner's email is onboarding@partner.com. Please use the following message: "Hi Team, Attached is NewAccounts_Oct.csv from our sales thread. Please begin the import and let us know if you need anything else. Thanks, [Your Name]." [END]
